column1: # PlasBench publication cohort: Teixeira et al. 2025 (Circling in on plasmids) (Teixeira et al. 2025, Briefings in Bioinformatics, doi 10.1093/bib/bbaf589).
# Built 2026-11-17 by python/build_publication_cohorts.py from the candidate ledger teixeira2025_candidates.tsv, public-v4 and NCBI resolution. 5 of 250 published isolates.
# Every row is tier B (no source publication reviewed here). truth_match says whether the assembly's plasmids are exactly the plasmids the paper used as truth.
# 250 isolates, 31 species. Most have no deposited complete assembly; only those that resolve to one are runnable without rebuilding the hybrid truth.
# Compare with the paper: plasbench compare-published --results-dir <results> --samples cohorts/pub-teixeira2025.tsv
